# Dropfolio

> Track what your CS2 drops are actually worth, priced against the Steam Community Market.

Dropfolio is a personal portfolio tracker for Counter-Strike 2 items. A user logs the cases,
skins, and graffiti they've picked up, and Dropfolio prices each one against the Steam
Community Market to show total portfolio value over time. Users can also set price alerts on
individual items and get notified when a target price is reached.

## Access

- Public pages: `/login`, `/register`.
- Everything else (dashboard, portfolio, drop history, price alerts, item catalog,
  notifications, account settings, and all admin tooling) requires a signed-in account and
  shows data private to that account. There is nothing else here for a crawler to index.

## Notes for automated agents

- This site does not have public API documentation, a public changelog, or a public support
  contact at this time. Please don't guess at or fabricate any of these — none currently exist.
- No user data, portfolio values, or account information should be treated as accessible
  without authentication; `robots.txt` and per-page metadata on this site both reflect that.
